Autonomous watchdog. Per ADR-L2-PAPERCLIPAI-004 §1.1: T0 routine = sub-agent dispatch self-monitoring. NO anti-paperclip veto. LANE PPR. Economics: M3 = $0.30/$1.20 per 1M tokens = ~$1.50/month for 24/7 routine T0.

CONTEXT DISCIPLINE (PPR, autocompact-safe, ASP-116 patch 2026-07-17):
- Hard cap on every log read: `multica daemon logs -n 30` (NEVER unbounded tail).
- NEVER run awk-grep over a full 1h window inline — count markers with bounded reads only.
- NEVER read daemon.log file directly; route all log reads through `multica daemon logs`.
- Hard cap comment history: read only `--recent 3` and only on the current issue id.
- Skip all comment-history reads on parent issues unless the current issue is explicitly blocked on parent context.
- Reuse `context-bloat-detector` skill only if pre-prompt introspection is required; do not load it for routine ticks.

FUNCTIONS (run on every heartbeat, cron */30 * * * * America/New_York):
1. F1 daemon status: `multica daemon status`. If stopped → `multica daemon start` (T0).
2. F2 runtime health: `multica runtime list --output json`. If Hermes/Codex offline > 1h → `multica runtime restart` (T0).
3. F3 BOUNDED ERROR/FAIL scan (replaces prior unbounded tail):
   a. `multica daemon logs -n 30 | grep -cE "ERROR|FAIL"` → distinct marker count.
   b. If count ≥ 3 in last 30 lines → T2 advisory: append single line to wiki/log.md naming the highest-severity marker + flag A0 in issue title (T2).
   c. NEVER cat/awk/grep more than 30 lines in one go.
4. F4 heartbeat: ALWAYS append one line 'Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK' to wiki/log.md (D4 append-only, single line, no full daemon log embedded).

VERIFICATION RECEIPT (mandatory each run, D1 verify-before-assert):
- daemon pid + uptime
- 7/7 runtime count (or named offline runtime)
- F3 bounded count (single integer)
- single-line heartbeat append verification (grep "Multica Self-Watchdog heartbeat OK" wiki/log.md)

ANTI-PAPERCLIP: T0 routine only. No external publish, no charge, no contract, no self-modifying code. Lane PPR. Reversal path: `multica autopilot update b3b2ef13-c1af-4fba-b73e-f82b5d0b0b8c --description "<prior text>"` (prior text recoverable from `multica autopilot get` history or git).
